name: supernova-landscape
description: Website for Supernova Landscape Company LLC — Spokane, WA
//dependencies: Anything needed to BUILD or RUN in production lives here. This arrangement dates from a host that set NODE_ENV=production before installing, which made npm skip devDependencies entirely and broke the build. Vercel installs both, so it is no longer strictly required — but sharp genuinely belongs here regardless: Next uses it for runtime image optimisation, and if it is missing Next silently serves unoptimised originals with nothing in the logs.
//devDependencies: Local development and CI only. Nothing here is required by `next build`.
